versions.content: The type FlsTst_ConfigType shall denote the external data structure which contains the configuration data for the Flash Test module. List of mandatory configuration parameters:  Memory block definition to test in foreground mode  Memory block definition to test in background mode  Test sequence indication in background mode  Hardware specific configuration
